reuse.why: Uses the existing link.assertAccountIsNotLinked, link.findOrCreateBank, bankSync.syncAccount and handleSyncResponse, but re-copies the upgrade/insert/sync/notify body rather than sharing it with the other providers.

duplication.why: linkFintegraAccount is a near-verbatim copy of linkSimpleFinAccount/linkAkahuAccount and downloadFintegraTransactions copies downloadAkahuTransactions, adding two more copies of provider-agnostic logic.

placement.why: Each piece lands where the tree keeps it: link handler in accounts/app.ts, download in accounts/sync.ts, endpoint in server-config.ts, type in types/models.

scope.why: Only the files needed to add the provider are touched.

maintainability.why: Follows the established per-provider pattern so it is easy to read, but every fix to the linking or download flow must now be repeated in one more copy.

bypasses_abstraction.where: The existing link.ts helpers and syncAccount dispatch are used; there is no shared link-account function in the tree to bypass.

disguised_duplication.where: linkFintegraAccount (accounts/app.ts) and downloadFintegraTransactions (accounts/sync.ts) are open copies of the sibling provider functions, slightly condensed but not disguised.
